name: job-agent
description: Open-source job-search skills: find and score roles, tailor your résumé, fill application forms in your browser up to Submit, track applications and prep for interviews. Uses the TrueInterview MCP for live jobs, real interview data and your saved records when you sign in, and your own local files when you don't.
shortDescription: Find, apply, track and prep for jobs
overviewDescription: How job-agent works: connected mode (TrueInterview MCP tools) vs local mode (the candidate's own files), which source to use for each need, the workspace, how to run the job-agent scripts, and the rules every job-search skill follows. Read it once at the start of any job-search, application, tracking or interview-prep task.
defaultPrompts: Set me up: here's my résumé
Find roles that fit me and are worth applying to
Apply to this job for me
